title: muhlenbergia mexicana f. commutata
intro: Muhlenbergia mexicana f. commutata, commonly known as Mexican grass, is a type of plant in the Poaceae family, native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. The health benefits of Mexican grass include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory agent and its ability to support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Muhlenbergia mexicana f. commutata include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
